name: Easy "Fish & Chip" Skewers with Homemade Tartar Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil (optional).
When the oven is heated, transfer fries (24 larger pieces) to one of the baking sheets and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake until starting to turn golden, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 14 oz steak cut French fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the fries are lightly golden, remove from the oven and flip. Return to the oven and continue to bake until golden and crispy, 12-15 minutes more. Remove from oven.
After flipping the fries, arrange fish sticks (12 pieces) on the second baking sheet and add to the oven. Bake, flipping halfway through, crisp and golden, 12-14 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice lemon into a small bowl.
Mince gherkins and capers. Add both to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo and spices. Stir to combine the tartar sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp capers
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¼ tsp dill, dried
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To assemble the skewers, build stacks with two fries and one fish stick, alternating ingredients, then secure with toothpicks.
Arrange "fish and chip" skewers on a platter; serve with tartar sauce for dipping. Enjoy!
